## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Narrow/Weak). Confirmations: SPY (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -1.80%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and QQQ (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -0.04%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND show equity weakness while VXX (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +12.75%) → flat | ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +2.81% | 1M: +7.26%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND show localized commodity-led strength, leaving the market mixed and neutral.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Commodity reflation and energy squeeze: USO (1W: +10.26% | 1M: +50.60%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +49.50%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Credit and rates mildly pressured: HYG (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -1.18%) → flat | BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.92% | 1M: -1.94%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND; volatility pickup flagged by VXX (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +12.75%) → flat | ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tightening: TLT (1W: -2.26% | 1M: -1.94%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.92% | 1M: -1.94%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND indicate higher yields/credit pressure, while official ratio panels are neutral, so conditions are mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy and Utilities leading: XLE (1W: +2.81% | 1M: +7.26%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and XLU (1W: +0.59% | 1M: +4.52%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -0.70% | 1M: -0.31%) → flat | BELOW TREND; style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow breadth.

5. US vs Global?
US soft: SPY (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -1.80%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND. Europe weak: VGK (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.88%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND; China showing signs of RECOVERY: FXI (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -4.60%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed but selective: IBIT (1W: +7.18% | 1M: +13.20%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and ETHA (1W: +14.57% | 1M: +21.78%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND show risk-on flows, while IWM (1W: -1.85% | 1M: -4.09%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -3.02% | 1M: +5.26%) ↓ falling | CORRECTION show uneven breadth.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad commodity strength driven by oil: USO (1W: +10.26% | 1M: +50.60%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +49.50%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and UGA (1W: +13.66% | 1M: +40.77%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND; copper CPER (1W: -0.58% | 1M: +0.51%) → flat | CORRECTION and precious metals GLD (1W: -2.56% | 1M: +2.00%) ↓ falling | CORRECTION show mixed signals.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy confirmed leading: XLE (1W: +2.81% | 1M: +7.26%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND, while natural gas UNG (1W: -0.81% | 1M: -1.77%) → flat | BELOW TREND remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: XLE (1W: +2.81% | 1M: +7.26%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +7.18% | 1M: +13.20%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND show clear multi-timeframe strength. DIVERGENCE: multiple CORRECTION setups (SLV (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +8.11%) ↓ falling | CORRECTION, GLD (1W: -2.56% | 1M: +2.00%) ↓ falling | CORRECTION, ARKK (1W: -3.02% | 1M: +5.26%) ↓ falling | CORRECTION) signal short-term noise—monitor.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor XLE (1W: +2.81% | 1M: +7.26%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +10.26% | 1M: +50.60%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +7.18% | 1M: +13.20%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND for tactical exposure; reduce exposure to broad equity beta like SPY (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -1.80%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and duration (TLT (1W: -2.26% | 1M: -1.94%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND) given yield pressure.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +2.81% | 1M: +7.26%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND if oil momentum persists. BEARISH: Financials — XLF (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -6.12%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND if credit tightness extends.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Oil/energy — BNO (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +49.50%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +10.26% | 1M: +50.60%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Silver — SLV (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +8.11%) ↓ falling | CORRECTION if short-term selling continues; Natural gas UNG (1W: -0.81% | 1M: -1.77%) → flat | BELOW TREND remains vulnerable.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (volatility complacency marker), HYG/LQD 0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLF 1.0–2.0 (style pivot range), SPY recent support zone ~ short-term BELOW TREND levels to watch.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive, narrow market with energy/utilities the only clear sector bright spots. Energy and commodities showing relative strength while multiple CORRECTION divergences in precious metals and innovation ETFs represent the key short-term risk to monitor.
